name: Ane to Princess wa Kirawaretakunai. -Ore no Lovecom 18 Kin Flag, Mata Shite mo Kanri Dekizu-
original_name: 姉とプリンセスは嫌われたくない。 －俺のラブコメ18禁フラグ、またしても管理できず－
source:
I was abducted and sent to a different world. As a substitute of the prince, I obtained the harem of Vinepoin princesses.

Even more than the immoral feeling of crossing the line with my elder sisters, it is harder to throw away the reign as the prince of the princesses who were raised to only serve while protecting their chastity.

Which world is the real one for me now...

Let's check the taste of my sister's nipples today.

Let's ask the taste of semen from the princesses tomorrow.

"Brother" or "Prince"...

The more reluctant I become in answering, the courting of my sisters and princesses are getting more aggressive and extreme.

Because I want you to come to like me, I want you to choose.

Tomorrow and even day after tomorrow, I am unable to decide the answer. Because neither my elder sisters, princesses nor I want to be hated.

Due to my sisters and princesses, the long, long rose coloured lewd life begins!

translation:
我被绑架后送到了异世界，作为王子的替身，获得了维尼邦公主们组成的后宫。

比起跨越与姐姐们之间禁忌界限的不道德感，更难舍弃的，是以王子身份统治那些从小被教育成只为侍奉他、同时守护贞洁的公主们。

对我来说，究竟哪个世界才是真实的……

今天先来确认姐姐乳头的味道吧。

明天再问问公主们精液的味道。

是叫“哥哥”，还是叫“王子”……

我越是不愿回答，姐姐们与公主们的追求就越发积极而激烈。

“因为我想让你喜欢上我，所以请你做出选择。”

明天，甚至后天，我也无法决定答案。因为姐姐们、公主们，还有我自己，都不想被人讨厌。

在姐姐们与公主们的推动下，漫长而绚丽的淫靡生活开始了！
